p: virgin of Israel is fallen: He so calls them, because they so boasted of themselves, or because they were given to lustfulness and daintiness.
an hundred: Meaning, that the tenth part would hardly be saved.
Gilgal: In those places they worshipped new idols, which before served for the true honour of God: therefore he says that these will not save them.
judgment to wormwood: Instead of judgment and fairness they execute cruelty and oppression.
maketh the seven stars and Orion: He describes the power of God; Job 9:9.
that rebuketh in the gate: They hate the Prophets, who reprove them in the open assemblies.
ye take from him burdens of: You take both his money and also his food, with which he should live.
the prudent shall keep silence in: God will so plague them that they will not allow the godly to open their mouths once to admonish them of their faults.
husbandman to mourning: So that people of all types will have reason to lament because of the great plagues.

desire the day of the LORD: He speaks in this way because the wicked and hypocrites said they were content to endure God's judgments, whereas the godly tremble and fear; Jer 30:7, Joe 2:2,11, Zep 1:15.
I will not accept them: Because you have corrupted my true service, and remain obstinate in your vices; Isa 1:11, Jer 6:10.
waters: Do your duty to God, and to your neighbour, and so you will plentifully feel his grace, if you show your abundant affections according to God's word.
Moloch and Chiun your images: That idol which you esteemed as your king, and carried about as you did Chiun, in which images you thought that there was a certain divinity.
